t: These are 45 and 46 Chandos Place, an office building in Covent Garden. It was designed by Frank Matcham, an architect far better known for theatres and music halls. He designed the Hippodrome, Hackney Empire, the Shepherd's Bush Empire, the Coliseum and the Palladium, and was responsible for over ninety theatres in all. So this is an unusual entry in his work, an office rather than a stage.
